title: Paya Lebar Air Base relocation and RSAF base concentration risks
asked: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat asked whether the Ministry had conducted a strategic review of the Paya Lebar Air Base relocation given drone and long-range munition threats, and whether concentrating RSAF assets into fewer air bases significantly raises first-strike risks.
response: Mr Chan Chun Sing said Singapore has no strategic depth, so the SAF develops operational concepts suited to its needs, with intelligence, early warning and layered capabilities. He said critical infrastructure is hardened, key assets can be dispersed, and reserve capacities provide resilience. He said the Paya Lebar relocation was carefully considered, with trade-offs, and that Tengah and Changi air bases are being expanded and upgraded, including against drones, while the Pulau Sudong contingency runway is lengthened. He added that the SAF will keep assessing requirements and that many efforts are not publicly disclosed.

key_points.point: Singapore is described as a small island with no strategic depth or hinterland to absorb an attack.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: as a small island with no strategic depth and hinterland to absorb an attack

key_points.point: Critical infrastructure and facilities are hardened, and key assets can be dispersed in peace time and during contingencies.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: our critical infrastructures and facilities are hardened against potential attacks, and our key assets can be dispersed in peace time and especially during contingencies

key_points.point: Reserve capacities are factored in for scenarios where some assets may be destroyed or damaged.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: We have also factored in reserve capacities to ensure resilience for scenarios where some of our assets may be destroyed or damaged

key_points.point: The decision to relocate Paya Lebar Air Base to free up land for national development was carefully considered.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: The decision to relocate Paya Lebar Air Base to free up land for national development purposes was a carefully considered one

key_points.point: Resources have been invested in expanding Tengah Air Base and Changi Air Base, and lengthening the contingency runway at Pulau Sudong.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: we have invested significant resources in expanding Tengah Air Base and Changi Air Base, and lengthening the contingency runway at Pulau Sudong

key_points.point: Tengah Air Base and Changi Air Base are being upgraded with better detection, response and resilience capabilities, including against drones.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: Tengah Air Base and Changi Air Base are also being upgraded with better detection, response and resilience capabilities, including against the emerging threats posed by drones

key_points.point: The SAF will continually assess its operational, infrastructure and capability requirements.
key_points.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
key_points.quote: The SAF will continually assess our operational, infrastructure and capability requirements
